Subject: Follow-up: ops & infra immersion — propose lock windows

Hi Alyssa / Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate the candid rundown of your production constraints and the perf/cost goals for inference. Quick recap: you want to validate that (1) we can meet 100ms P95 for short chat workloads, (2) maintain audit logs and retention for 12 months, and (3) have a rollout plan that keeps costs close to your current baseline.

Next step I recommend is a 60–90 minute ops + infra immersion with our ML/Infra engineers so we can walk traffic patterns, runbook expectations, and a short live trace of a sample request. Two proposals for locking a session:

- Option A: Tue Mar 21 — 10:00–11:30 PT (90 min)
- Option B: Thu Mar 23 — 13:00–14:15 PT (75 min)

Please tell us which slot you prefer (or send a few alternatives) and confirm attendees from your side. Also: any gov/compliance blockers (e.g., a procurement PO or an NDA) we should have in place before the deep dive?

I attached a draft mutual action plan and a short prep checklist for the session. On our side I’ll bring Ben (senior solutions engineer) and Rafael (inference platform lead). If there are specific traces or synthetic workloads you want us to stress in the session, paste a link or attach them to your reply.

Looking forward — we’ll hold both slots tentatively until we hear back.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0184
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (Excel/outline), tdx-prep-checklist.pdf (PDF/1pg)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary and the materials. Good recap. We’d like to prioritize a session that includes: ML lead (for inference tradeoffs) and one of our infra architects. Those are the people who will evaluate latency tradeoffs vs cost.

Availability from our side:
- Tue Mar 21: blocked late morning, can do 08:30–10:00 PT
- Thu Mar 23: 12:30–14:30 PT — that window works for both Tom and me

If possible, let’s go with Thu Mar 23 — 13:00–14:15 PT looks ideal.

Procurement: we don’t need an NDA for this session. Procurement will request a short SOC2 evidence pack if we proceed to evals; can you confirm we can share SOC2 summary docs ahead of the technical engagement?

Thanks,
Alyssa Morgan
